user_question: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of total hospital beds across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Sum hospital beds by tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate total hospital beds within each Centre County tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Use the hospital point layer and tract polygon layer. Spatially assign hospital points to polygons and sum the BEDS field for each polygon. Store the result in a field named total_beds.

workflow_steps.title: Create hospital beds choropleth map
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce an interactive choropleth showing total hospital beds by tract across Centre County with county subdivision boundaries.
workflow_steps.instructions: Create an interactive HTML choropleth using the total_beds field from the tract aggregation. Include the county subdivision polygon layer as a boundary reference layer.
